title: Weak keys, retired for real
prompt:
Inside Solution, keep `static class CacheKey { final String id; ... }` and a
`private static final WeakHashMap<CacheKey, String> store` with `static void put`,
`static String get`, plus:
1. `static int weakRetire()` — seed 3 key/value pairs from a PRIVATE helper (so the
key objects are reachable ONLY through the weak map once the helper returns), call
System.gc() twice, then return how many entries remain (probe store.size(), which
expunges cleared entries). Correct answer: 0.
2. `static int strongRetire()` — same seeding, but ALSO retain the keys in a
`static List<CacheKey> pinned`; gc twice; return survivors (correct: 3).

tests.name: weak keys are retired by the collector
tests.code:
checkEq(Solution.weakRetire(), 0, "unreachable keys die at GC (after enqueue lands)");
checkEq(Solution.strongRetire(), 3, "pinned keys survive the same GC");
tests.hint: Same collector, different reachability — different fates.
